summary.headline: PI Industries Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue fell 9% YoY to Rs 17,018 mn, with AgChem exports down 18% on ~13-14% price erosion and gross margin at 49%.
summary.overview: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue was Rs 17,018 million, down 9% YoY, with gross margin at 49% and EBITDA margin at 14%. AgChem exports fell 18%, with management attributing roughly 13-14 points to price and 3-4 points to volume amid genericization, weak monsoon and cautious channel buying. Domestic agri grew 19%, biologicals grew 45% domestically and more than 250% globally, and pharma grew 20%. Management said the first in-house NCE, Pioxazon (pioxaniliprole), was registered and launched in India, and reported working capital release of 18 days (Rs 298 crore) with a net cash position of about Rs 36 billion.

segments.name: AgChem exports (CSM)
segments.commentary: Exports down 18% YoY: volume down about 3-4%, price/cost down about 13-14%. Management is prioritising volume retention via price optimisation; cost increases could not be passed through.

segments.name: Domestic agri
segments.commentary: Grew 19% YoY on crop reach and product portfolio. Biologicals grew 45% and form about 18% of domestic agri.

segments.name: Global biologicals (PI AgSciences)
segments.commentary: Revenue about Rs 60 crore in Q2, up over 250% YoY. Distribution expanded in Brazil, Mexico, Spain and the US (3x distribution width). Plant healthcare loss expected at about USD 10+ million for FY27.

segments.name: Pharma CRDMO
segments.commentary: Revenue about Rs 75 crore in Q2, up 20% YoY. Hyderabad discovery centre operational, Lodi QC lab commissioned, kilo lab due by year end. Target of Rs 500-600 crore revenue and EBITDA breakeven over 2-3 years reiterated.

segments.name: Electronic and specialty chemicals
segments.commentary: Early commercial shoots; Udaipur kilo lab due to be operational by year end. Management targets about USD 100 million business in 3-4 years.

guidance_outlook: Gross margin guided at 48-49% for the next 2-3 quarters; management sees the 52-53% prior level as an exception and 50-52% as the long-term range.
FY27 revenue planned as flattish, per management's reply on last call's low single-digit growth comment.
Pricing pressure expected for the next couple of quarters; green shoots and volume pickup expected by end of FY28 (next financial year).
Plant healthcare (biologicals) expected to reach inflection (EBITDA positive) in 2-3 years; new-business start-up costs expected to flatten over 2-3 years.
Pioxazon scale-up scaling decision expected by end of this year after first-season feedback; regulatory filings progressing in other geographies.
Rabi season planned cautiously given soil moisture and reservoir levels below last year in several rain-fed belts.
capex_capacity: Management said agchem capacity is at saturation for the next 2-3 years, so capex will shift to new growth engines (pharma, biologicals, specialty chemicals).
Pharma Hyderabad discovery centre up; Lodi QC lab commissioned; kilo lab completing by end of year.
Udaipur electronic/specialty chemicals kilo lab to be operational by end of year.
Global biologicals footprint expansion in US, Brazil and Mexico is the largest current investment driver of overheads.
No specific capex quantum disclosed in the call.
demand_pricing: AgChem export pricing pressure is across the portfolio, including patented and innovator products, and across domestic and global markets; management described it as an industry-wide phenomenon.
Commodity prices have firmed from lows; if sustained, this could improve farm economics next season.
Weakest monsoon in over a decade; kharif acreage flat; growers bought late, less and cheaper.
New CSM molecules contribute about 16-18% of AgChem export revenue on an annual basis; more than 20 molecules commercialised in the last 3-5 years.
Order book about USD 1.25 billion on contract value basis; management said it can change with realisations and discounting.

qa_highlights.question: Split of the 18% AgChem export decline between volume and price?
qa_highlights.answer: Volume down about 3-4%; the rest (about 13-14%) is price and cost pressure.

qa_highlights.question: Breakdown of the Rs 1,227 crore export revenue across agchem, pharma and biologicals?
qa_highlights.answer: Global biologicals about Rs 60 crore and pharma about Rs 75 crore within exports; the agchem split was not stated separately.

qa_highlights.question: Normalised gross and EBITDA margin levels?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin currently 47-48% per management; the target held is 48-49%, with 50-52% as the historic guidance range.

qa_highlights.question: Drivers of the 6% rise in new-business overheads and loss at plant healthcare?
qa_highlights.answer: Primarily pharma and biologicals, mainly biologicals expansion in the US, Brazil and Mexico. Plant healthcare loss about USD 10+ million for the full year.

qa_highlights.question: Electronics ramp-up timing and size?
qa_highlights.answer: Early shoots visible; good ramp-up next year; target about USD 100 million business in 3-4 years.

qa_highlights.question: Contract assets trend and guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Around Rs 700 crore, expected to stay in the same range for the next few quarters; these are committed POs for patented products.

qa_highlights.question: Pioxazon market size and revenue expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: No number committed; launch this month, scale decision by end of this year after one season of field feedback. Labels to expand beyond rice, corn and Bengal gram.

qa_highlights.question: Peak potential of new CSM molecules?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to commit; said it could be in the USD 300-400 million range in 3-5 years but would not hold to that figure.

risks_watch: Continued AgChem export price erosion from genericization of the largest molecule and industry-wide pricing pressure; the 13-14% price decline may persist for a couple of quarters.
Gross margin recovery depends on raw material and oil/dollar swings; management said margin benefits lag by a couple of quarters.
Start-up losses in biologicals and pharma keep overheads elevated (Rs 609 crore Q2) for 2-3 years.
Pharma CDMO target (Rs 500-600 crore and EBITDA breakeven in 2-3 years) depends on deals in the pipeline; a contract slippage flagged last quarter.
Weak Rabi outlook given below-normal soil moisture and reservoir levels in rain-fed belts.
summary.management_tone: Candid but defensive: management acknowledged a difficult cycle and pricing pressure, while repeatedly deferring hard numbers on molecule potential, pricing floors and Pioxazon sales. Confidence centred on long-term platforms, with several answers (market share, peak potential, electronics scale) left unquantified.
key_quotes: This has been a difficult quarter in a difficult year for the industry.
The gross margin as we said is about today at 47%-48%.
Pioxaniliprole branded as Pioxazon, our first new chemical entity has received a registration in India and has been launched as Pioxazon
I would not hold myself to that number, as I said it is difficult to put that down.

rows.why: Net working capital cut by 18 days (Rs 298 crore) and operating cash flow rose to Rs 9.1 bn from Rs 2.3 bn YoY, leaving net cash of about Rs 36 bn.
